list.name: class

list.name: track_type

list.query: SELECT DISTINCT track_type FROM race_sessions ORDER BY track_type

list.name: player

list.query: SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS __text, p.id AS __value FROM players p JOIN race_results rr ON rr.player_id=p.id ORDER BY __text

panels.title: OVERVIEW · server race activity and headline metrics
FIVEM SERVER HEALTH · reachability, uptime and outages
FiveM Endpoint · current status
panels.description: Most recent TCP reachability check for the configured FiveM server endpoint.

targets.rawSql: SELECT checked_at AS time, is_up AS value FROM server_health_checks ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Availability · last 24h
panels.description: Share of 30-second probes that reached the configured TCP endpoint during the past 24 hours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG(is_up) AS value FROM server_health_checks WHERE checked_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.title: Downtime · last 24h
panels.description: Estimated unreachable time based on consecutive failed probes. A single failed interval is approximately the configured poll interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_up=0 THEN LEAST(interval_seconds, GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, checked_at, COALESCE(LEAD(checked_at) OVER (ORDER BY checked_at), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))))) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM server_health_checks WHERE checked_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.title: Latest Response Time
panels.description: TCP connect latency of the most recent successful health probe.

targets.rawSql: SELECT checked_at AS time, latency_ms AS value FROM server_health_checks WHERE is_up=1 ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Players Online
panels.description: Player count most recently reported by FiveM's /dynamic.json endpoint. The trend below also shows server capacity when published.

targets.rawSql: SELECT checked_at AS time, players_online AS value FROM server_health_checks WHERE is_up=1 ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Reachability & Response Time
panels.description: Availability steps and successful TCP probe latency over time. TCP reachability does not assert that a player can complete a FiveM handshake.

targets.rawSql: SELECT checked_at AS time, is_up AS value FROM server_health_checks WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) ORDER BY checked_at
SELECT checked_at AS time, latency_ms AS value FROM server_health_checks WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) AND is_up=1 ORDER BY checked_at

panels.title: Recent Outages & Failed Checks
panels.description: Latest failed TCP health checks, including probe time and connection error.

targets.rawSql: SELECT checked_at AS 'Checked at (UTC)', error_text AS 'Failure reason' FROM server_health_checks WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) AND is_up=0 ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Players Online vs Capacity
panels.description: Player count and published capacity from the FiveM /dynamic.json endpoint.

targets.rawSql: SELECT checked_at AS time, players_online AS value FROM server_health_checks WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) AND is_up=1 ORDER BY checked_at
SELECT checked_at AS time, max_players AS value FROM server_health_checks WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) AND is_up=1 ORDER BY checked_at
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM race_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rr.player_id) AS value FROM race_results rr JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}'
SELECT AVG(duration_ms) AS value FROM race_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}'

SELECT 100*SUM(rr.dnf=1)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM race_results rr JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}'

panels.title: RACE ACTIVITY · participation, tracks, classes and recent results

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at,'1d') AS time, COUNT(*) AS races FROM race_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT track, COUNT(*) AS races FROM race_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY track ORDER BY races DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT $__timeGroup(rs.created_at,'1d') AS time, SUM(rs.player_count) AS Starters, SUM(COALESCE(r.finishers,0)) AS Finishers FROM race_sessions rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT race_id, SUM(CASE WHEN dnf=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishers FROM race_results GROUP BY race_id) r ON r.race_id=rs.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rs.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeGroup(rr.created_at,'1d') AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT rr.player_id) AS racers FROM race_results rr JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT car_class AS class, COUNT(*) AS races FROM race_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY car_class

SELECT CASE WHEN dnf=1 THEN 'DNF' WHEN position>10 THEN 'P11+' ELSE CONCAT('P',position) END AS Result, COUNT(*) AS Drivers FROM race_results rr JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY Result ORDER BY MIN(position)

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(rr.dnf_reason,''),'Unspecified') AS Reason, COUNT(*) AS DNFs FROM race_results rr JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rr.dnf=1 AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY Reason ORDER BY DNFs DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT rs.created_at AS Time, rs.track AS Track, rs.track_type AS Type, rs.car_class AS Class, rs.laps AS Laps, rs.player_count AS Starters, ROUND(rs.duration_ms/1000,1) AS DurationSeconds FROM race_sessions rs WHERE $__timeFilter(rs.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' ORDER BY rs.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT rr.created_at AS Time, p.username AS Driver, rs.track AS Track, rr.position AS Position, ROUND(rr.finish_time/1000,2) AS FinishSeconds, ROUND(rr.best_lap/1000,2) AS BestLapSeconds, rr.dnf AS DNF, rr.dnf_reason AS DNFReason FROM race_results rr JOIN players p ON p.id=rr.player_id JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: TRACK VISUALIZATION · GTA V route layouts
SPZ Track Routes · GTA V map
panels.description: Circuit and sprint layouts over Rockstar GTA V map tiles. Use the route explorer link for per-track search and selection.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tr.track AS Track, tr.car_class AS Class, p.username AS Driver, tr.best_time AS BestTimeMs, tr.best_lap AS BestLapMs, tr.set_at AS SetAt FROM track_records tr JOIN players p ON p.id=tr.player_id WHERE tr.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND tr.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' ORDER BY tr.best_time ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT $__timeGroup(rr.created_at,'1d') AS time, MIN(NULLIF(rr.best_lap,0)) AS BestLapMs, AVG(NULLIF(rr.best_lap,0)) AS AverageLapMs FROM race_results rr JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' AND rr.dnf=0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: PLAYER DETAILS · career, race history and leaderboard
Selected Driver · Career Summary

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.username AS Driver, COUNT(rr.id) AS Races, SUM(rr.dnf=0 AND rr.position=1) AS Wins, SUM(rr.dnf=0 AND rr.position<=3) AS Podiums, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rr.dnf=0 THEN rr.position END),2) AS AvgFinish, SUM(rr.dnf=1) AS DNFs, COALESCE(i.Incidents,0) AS Crashes, ROUND(100*SUM(rr.dnf=0 AND rr.position<=3)/NULLIF(COUNT(rr.id),0),1) AS PodiumRatePct FROM players p JOIN race_results rr ON rr.player_id=p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT player_id,COUNT(*) AS Incidents FROM race_incidents GROUP BY player_id) i ON i.player_id=p.id WHERE 1=1 AND rr.player_id REGEXP '${player:regex}' AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY p.id,p.username,i.Incidents ORDER BY Races DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Select one player in the Player filter for a single-driver summary.

panels.title: Player Results · race by race

targets.rawSql: SELECT rr.created_at AS Time,p.username AS Driver,rs.track AS Track,rs.track_type AS Type,rr.position AS Position,rr.dnf AS DNF,rr.dnf_reason AS DNFReason,ROUND(rr.finish_time/1000,2) AS FinishSeconds,ROUND(rr.best_lap/1000,2) AS BestLapSeconds,rr.personal_best AS PersonalBest,rr.sr_change AS SRChange,rr.irating_change AS IRatingChange FROM race_results rr JOIN players p ON p.id=rr.player_id JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rr.player_id REGEXP '${player:regex}' AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Detailed result history for the selected player and dashboard filters.

panels.title: Player Pace · best lap by race

targets.rawSql: SELECT rr.created_at AS time,ROUND(rr.best_lap/1000,2) AS BestLapSeconds,ROUND(rr.finish_time/1000,2) AS FinishSeconds FROM race_results rr JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rr.dnf=0 AND rr.best_lap>0 AND rr.player_id REGEXP '${player:regex}' AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' ORDER BY time

panels.description: Compare best-lap pace and total race time for the selected driver.

panels.title: Player Crash Trend

targets.rawSql: SELECT ri.created_at AS time,COUNT(*) AS Impacts,ROUND(AVG(ri.speed_kmh),1) AS AvgImpactKmh,MAX(ri.speed_drop_kmh) AS MaxSpeedDropKmh FROM race_incidents ri JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=ri.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ri.created_at) AND ri.player_id REGEXP '${player:regex}' AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Hard impacts detected by SPZ; only data recorded after migration 019 is available.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.username AS Driver, COUNT(*) AS Podiums, SUM(rr.position=1) AS Wins, ROUND(AVG(rr.position),2) AS AvgPosition FROM race_results rr JOIN players p ON p.id=rr.player_id JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rr.dnf=0 AND rr.position<=3 AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY rr.player_id,p.username ORDER BY Podiums DESC,Wins DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Player Leaderboard · wins, podiums and clean races

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.username AS Driver,COUNT(rr.id) AS Races,SUM(rr.dnf=0 AND rr.position=1) AS Wins,SUM(rr.dnf=0 AND rr.position<=3) AS Podiums,ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rr.dnf=0 THEN rr.position END),2) AS AvgPosition,SUM(rr.dnf=1) AS DNFs,ROUND(100*SUM(rr.dnf=0 AND rr.position<=3)/NULLIF(COUNT(rr.id),0),1) AS PodiumRatePct FROM players p JOIN race_results rr ON rr.player_id=p.id JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' GROUP BY p.id,p.username,i.Crashes ORDER BY Wins DESC,Podiums DESC,Races DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: CRASH INVESTIGATION · GTA V crash map and density heatmap
Crash Locations · GTA V map

targets.rawSql: SELECT ri.created_at AS time, p.username AS Player, rs.track AS Track, ri.race_id AS RaceId, ri.speed_kmh AS ImpactKmh, ri.speed_drop_kmh AS SpeedDropKmh, ri.x AS GameX, ri.y AS GameY, ri.z AS GameZ, CASE WHEN ri.y < -1000 THEN 6.23122700084464e-14*POW(ri.y,4) + 4.20129073856139e-10*POW(ri.y,3) + 2.33168021020044e-6*POW(ri.y,2) + 0.0240131069198339*ri.y + 14.1346597090657 WHEN ri.y < 2000 THEN -5.48114969721267e-14*POW(ri.y,4) - 1.7644651413213e-10*POW(ri.y,3) - 6.69398961485353e-7*POW(ri.y,2) + 0.019446455419011*ri.y + 11.948776738614 WHEN ri.y < 5000 THEN -7.50970630545523e-15*POW(ri.y,4) + 2.42587620752267e-10*POW(ri.y,3) - 3.39800162545523e-6*POW(ri.y,2) + 0.02514652658967*ri.y + 7.49474095495398 ELSE -2.33545837309061e-14*POW(ri.y,4) + 6.7194107532233e-10*POW(ri.y,3) - 7.73181068541832e-6*POW(ri.y,2) + 0.0443322941450463*ri.y - 23.9182574396233 END AS latitude, CASE WHEN ri.y < -1000 THEN -3.03663255576895e-9*ri.x*ri.x + 0.0200175350440883*ri.x - 97.211789757094 WHEN ri.y < 2000 THEN 2.04927570146569e-8*ri.x*ri.x + 0.0199382651698616*ri.x - 97.2328189248356 WHEN ri.y < 5000 THEN 1.14491978248603e-8*ri.x*ri.x + 0.0199665146367798*ri.x - 97.2865999889282 ELSE -4.51344244634536e-8*ri.x*ri.x + 0.0200135106227036*ri.x - 97.1355799536373 END AS longitude FROM race_incidents ri JOIN players p ON p.id=ri.player_id JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=ri.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ri.created_at) AND ri.player_id REGEXP '${player:regex}' AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' ORDER BY ri.created_at DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.description: Each marker is a verified hard-impact event. Hover markers for player, track, speed and coordinates.

panels.title: Crash Density · GTA V heatmap

targets.rawSql: SELECT ri.created_at AS time, p.username AS Player, rs.track AS Track, ri.race_id AS RaceId, ri.speed_kmh AS ImpactKmh, ri.speed_drop_kmh AS SpeedDropKmh, ri.x AS GameX, ri.y AS GameY, ri.z AS GameZ, CASE WHEN ri.y < -1000 THEN 6.23122700084464e-14*POW(ri.y,4) + 4.20129073856139e-10*POW(ri.y,3) + 2.33168021020044e-6*POW(ri.y,2) + 0.0240131069198339*ri.y + 14.1346597090657 WHEN ri.y < 2000 THEN -5.48114969721267e-14*POW(ri.y,4) - 1.7644651413213e-10*POW(ri.y,3) - 6.69398961485353e-7*POW(ri.y,2) + 0.019446455419011*ri.y + 11.948776738614 WHEN ri.y < 5000 THEN -7.50970630545523e-15*POW(ri.y,4) + 2.42587620752267e-10*POW(ri.y,3) - 3.39800162545523e-6*POW(ri.y,2) + 0.02514652658967*ri.y + 7.49474095495398 ELSE -2.33545837309061e-14*POW(ri.y,4) + 6.7194107532233e-10*POW(ri.y,3) - 7.73181068541832e-6*POW(ri.y,2) + 0.0443322941450463*ri.y - 23.9182574396233 END AS latitude, CASE WHEN ri.y < -1000 THEN -3.03663255576895e-9*ri.x*ri.x + 0.0200175350440883*ri.x - 97.211789757094 WHEN ri.y < 2000 THEN 2.04927570146569e-8*ri.x*ri.x + 0.0199382651698616*ri.x - 97.2328189248356 WHEN ri.y < 5000 THEN 1.14491978248603e-8*ri.x*ri.x + 0.0199665146367798*ri.x - 97.2865999889282 ELSE -4.51344244634536e-8*ri.x*ri.x + 0.0200135106227036*ri.x - 97.1355799536373 END AS longitude FROM race_incidents ri JOIN players p ON p.id=ri.player_id JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=ri.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ri.created_at) AND ri.player_id REGEXP '${player:regex}' AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' ORDER BY ri.created_at DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.description: High-density areas are highlighted from recorded crash incidents. Available after migration 019 and updated race resource deployment.

panels.title: Crash Details · time, severity and exact game coordinates

targets.rawSql: SELECT ri.created_at AS Time,p.username AS Driver,rs.track AS Track,ri.race_id AS RaceId,ROUND(ri.elapsed_ms/1000,1) AS RaceSeconds,ri.speed_kmh AS ImpactKmh,ri.speed_drop_kmh AS SpeedDropKmh,ROUND(ri.x,1) AS GameX,ROUND(ri.y,1) AS GameY,ROUND(ri.z,1) AS GameZ FROM race_incidents ri JOIN players p ON p.id=ri.player_id JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=ri.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ri.created_at) AND ri.player_id REGEXP '${player:regex}' AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' AND rs.track_type REGEXP '${track_type:regex}' ORDER BY ri.created_at DESC LIMIT 500

panels.description: Crash locations and impact speeds are collected from races run after migration 019 and the matching race-resource update.

panels.title: POLL ANALYTICS · votes, rerolls and outcomes

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(pr.ended_at,'1d') AS time, CONCAT(po.phase, ': ', po.option_key) AS metric, SUM(po.vote_count) AS votes FROM race_poll_runs pr JOIN race_poll_options po ON po.poll_id=pr.poll_id AND po.attempt=pr.attempt WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.ended_at) GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

SELECT ended_at AS Time, race_type AS Type, eligible_count AS Eligible, voter_count AS Voters, track_winner AS Track, vehicle_winner AS Vehicle, traffic_winner AS Traffic, cop_chase AS Cops, rerolled AS Rerolled FROM race_poll_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND rerolled=0 ORDER BY ended_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT 100*SUM(rerolled=1)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM race_poll_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at)
SELECT 100*AVG(voter_count/NULLIF(eligible_count,0)) AS value FROM race_poll_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND rerolled=0
SELECT $__timeGroup(ended_at,'1d') AS time, SUM(cop_chase_yes) AS YesVotes, SUM(cop_chase_no) AS NoVotes FROM race_poll_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND rerolled=0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
